pr_title: fix(test-runner): WebServer > Use socket for reuseExistingServer to detect servers that aren't using SO_REUSEADDR
pr_body:
Fixes #8513

There are two potential cause that I'm aware for the above linked bug:

1. A server is running on a specific local host (e.g. 127.0.0.1) while the test assumes none (defaulting to `locahost`).
2. A server is running that doesn't use `SO_REUSEADDR`.

This PR fixes both causes by using a socket connection to test if the port is in use, instead of trying to start a server on the port. Funny enough this was exactly what the code was already doing _after_ starting the server, to check if it is up already.

I still like the suggestion made to make the host configurable, but for other reasons, which is that it would indirectly set `baseURL` to meet the user's expectation better.
pr_comments:
This looks good!

Regarding tests, see here: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/385d489b35ad5bc3b28c78c05b9c04e87400bd22/tests/playwright-test/web-server.spec.ts

As a command I'd pass a small Node.js script which does `process.exit(1)` since it never should get executed. And then create a test where you loop over `127.0.0.1` and `0.0.0.0` to ensure both is working. The actual servers you start inside the tests and stop it at the end of the test.

Let us know if you have any questions.

issue_context.title: [BUG] `webServer.reuseExistingServer` doesn't work with servers bound to a specific address
comments: To what address is Vite is binding the port to, do you want to have it configurable instead?
Vite defaults to `'127.0.0.1'`. From my PoV, a `webServer.hostname` option in addition to the existing `port` one would be enough.

The current implementation also doesn't detect servers that aren't running with `SO_REUSEADDR`.

Funny enough using a socket like Playwright does in `waitForSocket` _would_:

https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/d3a8c38b7e8a8bbf5aea0f7d9ad277f02a292bd9/src/test/webServer.ts#L121-L129

I'll do a PR to repurpose that to fix this issue.

review_comments: Replaced `canBindPort` by `isPortUsed` using the code in `waitForSocket`, which now uses this function along with the above private `WebServer._startProcess`.
